notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hey, capybara seekers!

In this update, we've fixed a rare bug reported by one of the players and improved the quality of effects.

Full changelog:

- Fixed a very rare bug that caused unintended camera movement without player input.
- Increased the quality of visual effects when clicking on a capybara and upon finding all capybaras.
- Optimized some graphics, which should slightly reduce the game's disk size.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, capybara seekers![/h2]

We are happy to announce that [b]Hidden Capybaras with Orange: Spooky Halloween Edition[/b] can proudly sport the [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b] badge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45250443/2c57cf2294b0b92efeef50892456e147208cbdae.png[/img]

We’ve also updated the game to include camera control using the keyboard and improved controls on the Steam Deck. Additionally, we’ve added a recommended default configuration on Steam Deck.

Here’s the full list of changes:

[list]
[*] Added camera control using the WSAD or arrow keys
[*] Added Default Controller Configuration for Steam Deck
[*] Improved cursor behavior on Steam Deck
[*] Updated some graphics in the main menu
[/list]

We hope you’re enjoying our game. We look forward to your feedback!
